description: Frame any photo as a classic polaroid with a white border and your own caption.

faqs.a: Your photo on a white polaroid-style frame with a wider bottom border carrying your caption text.
faqs.q: What does the polaroid look like?

faqs.a: Type any caption (up to 60 characters) in the caption field.
faqs.q: Can I add my own text?

faqs.a: A lossless PNG with a transparent-safe white frame.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Type a caption for the polaroid.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Polaroid Frame
